name: @runsecure/hkdfguard-pipeline-hashicorpvault
description: HkdfGuard secret pipeline writer over HashiCorp Vault's KV secrets engine (Node's own HTTPS client): pulls a fixed list of secrets, parsed straight from the response stream, encrypts each at once with a PipelineDataProtector bound to its file name, and writes one file per secret for FilePerSecretCache.
